ayahs.tj: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ ١
ayahs.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
And We removed from you your burden

ayahs.tj: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ ٣
ayahs.en: Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.

ayahs.tj: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ٥
ayahs.en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.

ayahs.tj: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ٦
فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ ٧
ayahs.en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

ayahs.tj: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب ٨
ayahs.en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
